fields.default:
Where it lives

You choose a region when you create a workspace: Canada, the European Union, the United States or Australia. Recordings never leave that region, not even for backups.

Who can see it

Only people you invite to a project can play its recordings. Shared highlight links expire after 30 days unless you renew them.

How long we keep it

By default we keep recordings for 24 months and transcripts until you delete them. Admins can shorten both in workspace settings.

When you leave

Export everything as audio, video and text in one click. Thirty days after you close a workspace, we delete it from every server and backup.
